Details: Open this notebook in its repository location and evaluate the package-loading cell first. GAP with JSON and IO workspace support is required. Loading alone does not start GAP.

This complete workflow builds the recorded 24-3I realization with its verified irreducible representations (the builder's default representation stage: unitary, and here also T-diagonal through SL2Reps), saves and imports its exact mathematical data including the matrices, restores retained state and computes a normal subgroup later. After eviction, a typed construction can be reconstructed while preserving characters, representations and IDs.

The example isolates the GAP cache in a temporary directory, restores your configuration and removes its files. SaveGroupData registers the saved mathematical bytes in the independent local export ledger, which GAP cache cleanup does not remove.

Check FailureQ before using an operation result. Operational failures return structured data with applicable attempt diagnostics and partial results; a successful-looking process exit is not sufficient. The example stops on the first failure and still performs cleanup.
